violated_contract: Recovery of an interrupted durable event must not assign the recovery wall clock as its event end. Desktop crash recovery passed crashRecovery to finishSession, but finishSession unconditionally stamped Date(), turning a short recording recovered four days later into a multi-day capture interval that from-segments uploaded unchanged.
canonical_prevention: Resolve the recovered end at the transactional persistence boundary: preserve a valid persisted end, otherwise derive it from the maximum valid durable relative segment end. Withhold upload when no valid evidence exists; retain ordinary explicit-stop semantics. Exercise delayed and repeated recovery against an isolated production database and inspect the actual encoded upload through a hermetic transport.
